name: Jellies

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows superior Slayer monsters, including Vitreous Jellies, to spawn while on task.

unlocks.name: I Wildy More Slayer
unlocks.notes: Free toggleable reward that controls whether Krystilia can assign jellies as a Wilderness task; toggled off she will not assign it.

variantInfo.name: Jelly
notes: Standard jellies with an unusually high Defence level for their combat level.
It is not recommended to kill normal jellies in most circumstances because they have a fairly poor drop table and are far from a bank.

variantInfo.name: Warped Jelly
notes: Stronger version of jellies in the Catacombs of Kourend with a better loot table, including ancient shards and dark totem pieces.

variantInfo.name: Chilled Jelly
notes: Same level as Warped Jellies with slightly different drops; found in a single combat area.
Chilled Jellies have a 50% susceptibility to fire spells.

variantInfo.name: Vitreous Jelly
notes: Superior slayer monster variant of the Jelly, unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
Max hit 17 with no special mechanics.

variantInfo.name: Vitreous warped Jelly
notes: Superior slayer monster variant of the Warped Jelly, unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
Max hit 19 with no special mechanics.

variantInfo.name: Vitreous chilled Jelly
notes: Superior slayer monster variant of the Chilled Jelly, unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
Max hit 19 with no special mechanics.

locationComparison.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: Safespotting is possible by firing over the corner of the rocks in the west and south sides.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Warped Jellies here have a better loot table, including ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
Safespotting is possible by firing over corners.
Multicombat - Ice Burst or Ice Barrage give the fastest kills.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Players can easily escape with a one-click teleport such as a royal seed pod.
Popular player killing hotspot - do not risk items you are unwilling to lose.

locationComparison.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
notes: Chilled Jellies can be safespotted by standing behind the smaller icicles.
Single combat area; Chilled Jellies are 50% susceptible to fire spells.

taskNotes: Jellies can be assigned by Krystilia, Vannaka, Chaeldar, and Konar upon reaching 52 Slayer and 57 combat.
Jellies attack with magic-based melee; Protect from Melee will negate all damage taken.
Jellies have an unusually high Defence level compared to other similar monsters around their level.
In multicombat areas, Jellies may be killed with Magic for the fastest possible kills by using multi-target Ancient Magicks such as Ice Burst or Ice Barrage.
Ranged with the Venator bow is a lower-effort alternative that cannot match Magic kill speed.
Krystilia tasks must be completed in the Wilderness, at the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Warped Jellies in the Catacombs of Kourend have a better loot table and drop ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
Chilled Jellies in the Ruins of Tapoyauik are 50% susceptible to fire spells and sit in a single combat area.
Jellies drop hard clue scrolls, making them a popular clue farming target.
Vitreous, Vitreous warped, and Vitreous chilled Jellies are the superior versions unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
The slayerTargetId 242 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract, 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Melee with Protect from Melee is the simple default. In the multicombat Catacombs of Kourend, Ice Burst or Ice Barrage Warped Jellies for the fastest kills; the Venator bow is a low-effort ranged alternative.
